boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-Los Angeles
boards.description: Ten documented food stops on or near the UCLA–Westwood edge with currently published evening or overnight hours.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger
cards.subtitle: 922 Gayley Ave, south of UCLA
cards.notes: Use the Gayley location when you need a straightforward late food stop; confirm the day’s posted closing time before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Gayley Avenue counter-service stop with hours extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists normal hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and places it south of UCLA.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — Los Angeles, CA, 922 Gayley
cards.access_notes: Officially posted normal hours: 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on Broxton
cards.subtitle: 1008 Broxton Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: Walk to Broxton for an all-week late counter-service option; check the location page again if a holiday or special schedule applies.
cards.short_summary: A Broxton Avenue restaurant whose published hours run to 2 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s official Broxton Avenue page lists 10:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted dine-in and drive-thru hours are 10:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Fat Sal's Westwood
cards.subtitle: 972 Gayley Ave, Westwood Village
cards.notes: Choose this Gayley Avenue sandwich shop for a late pickup or sit-down; use its official page to reconfirm the daily schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood Village sandwich destination with 2 a.m. daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Sal’s official Westwood page lists its address as 972 Gayley Ave and daily hours of 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours: daily, 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.

cards.title: Enzo's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 1145 Westwood Blvd, Westwood Village
cards.notes: Plan a pizza or pasta pickup from the Westwood Boulevard storefront, especially on a night when its later published weekend hours apply.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood Village pizzeria open later on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Enzo’s official site lists 1145 Westwood Blvd and published Friday–Saturday dine-in, delivery, and takeout hours until 3:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday dine-in, delivery, and takeout until 3:00 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday hours extend to 11:30 p.m.

cards.title: Denny's on Tiverton
cards.subtitle: 1060 Tiverton Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: Keep this Tiverton Avenue diner in mind for an overnight meal; the official location directory labels this branch open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood diner explicitly listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official Westwood location directory identifies Denny’s at 1060 Tiverton Ave as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists the 1060 Tiverton Ave restaurant as “Open 24 Hours.”

cards.title: Tu Madre Westwood
cards.subtitle: 1945 Westwood Blvd, Westwood
cards.notes: Head south on Westwood Boulevard for its counter-service Mexican food and consult the official page before a late pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood Boulevard restaurant with midnight hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Tu Madre’s official Westwood page lists 1945 Westwood Blvd and hours until 12:00 a.m. Monday–Friday and Saturday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours: 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Monday–Friday and 10:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: Fatburger on Kinross
cards.subtitle: 10955 Kinross Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: Use the Kinross Avenue location for a later dinner window; verify the weekday because the official closing time varies by day.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood burger restaurant with select 11 p.m. closing nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Fatburger’s official Westwood page lists 10955 Kinross Ave and closing at 11:00 p.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours extend to 11:00 p.m. Thursday–Saturday; other listed days close at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Mr. Noodle
cards.subtitle: 936 Broxton Ave, Westwood
cards.notes: For an evening noodle meal on Broxton, use the restaurant’s official hours and aim for the 10 p.m. closing window on most days.
cards.short_summary: A Broxton Avenue Thai and noodle restaurant open to 10 p.m. most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Mr. Noodle’s official site lists 936 Broxton Ave and hours until 10:00 p.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours: 8:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Monday–Friday, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Saturday, and noon–9:00 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Westwood Thai Cafe
cards.subtitle: 1375 Westwood Blvd, Westwood
cards.notes: Make this a dinner or late pickup stop along Westwood Boulevard; the official site lists a 10 p.m. close every day.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood Boulevard Thai restaurant with nightly 10 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Westwood Thai Cafe’s official site lists 1375 Westwood Blvd and hours until 10:00 p.m. Monday–Saturday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours: 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 5:00 p.m.–10:00 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Mr Rice Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1010 Broxton Ave, UCLA/Westwood
cards.notes: Use the Broxton Avenue location for an evening rice-noodle or rice-bowl meal, allowing time before its published 9 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A UCLA/Westwood rice-noodle restaurant with a documented evening service window.
cards.evidence_claim: Mr Rice’s official site identifies its UCLA/Westwood location at 1010 Broxton Ave and lists hours of 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted UCLA/Westwood hours: 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.
